thread:
maria: Heads-up — p99 latency went from ~120ms to ~380ms across hosted us-west-1 starting ~10:12 UTC. Appears right after the quantize kernel rollout to g11. Any quick theories? :thinking:

kevin: I see the same in metrics. KV cache hit-rate dropped from 92% -> 68% on those instances. Also a spike in kernel fallback events (quantize -> fp16). Logs excerpt: 
```
2026-03-18T10:12:04Z kernel_select: model=my-chat quantize=true selected=quantize_v2 status=fallback reason=host_mem_pressure
2026-03-18T10:12:05Z kv_cache_evict: host=gw-14 mem_pressure=1 evicted=12345
2026-03-18T10:12:06Z batching:recompute_hysteresis new_window=8ms old=5ms
```

sre-jen: Could be host-level memory thrash causing kernel selection to prefer safer (but slower) paths. Can we get dmesg/cgroup memory stats from affected nodes?

ops-bot: deploy event: quantize/rollout/quantize-v2 -> prod (us-west-1) by @kevin at 2026-03-18T10:10:58Z :rocket:

ryan: Noted autoscaler also shows a backlog of provision requests around the same time. If new requests hit nodes with high eviction, warm pool won't cover them and we see coldpath slowdowns. Autoscaler log: 
```
2026-03-18T10:11:50Z provisioner: request queued id=prov-824 ttl=30s reason=burst
2026-03-18T10:12:12Z provisioner: warmpool_miss region=us-west-1 need=12 have=4
```

maria: So two compounding issues: quantize rollout triggered kernel fallback under memory pressure -> KV evictions -> batching windows expanded -> p99 spike. And warm pool shortage meant many requests hit cold or degraded nodes.

samir: Quick mitigation suggestions:
- pin routing for high qps models to previous kernel variant for us-west-1
- increase warm pool by 30% for 30m to absorb burst
- tighten batching hysteresis back to previous value (5ms) temporarily

kevin: I can roll back the quantize-v2 canary in prod; starting rollback now. Also toggling kernel preference in router for the model.

deploy-bot: rollback triggered: quantize/rollout/quantize-v2 -> rollback by @kevin at 2026-03-18T10:18:03Z

ops-bot: warmpool scale: requested +30% for us-west-1, request id wp-992 (pending quota checks).

sre-jen: Adding immediate monitors: kv_miss_rate > 10% alert, host_memory_pressure > 0.5 alert, kernel_fallback_rate > 5% alert. Also adding a perf probe to capture stack traces on fallback path for next 24h.

kevin: After rollback the p99 came back down to ~140ms within ~3m. KV hit-rate recovering. Looks like rollback fixed it for now.

ryan: Follow-up root-cause ideas: quantize kernel increased transient RSS because of a compilation path that allocates a transient buffer per-request. Under high packing it exceeded soft-limits and hit host-level eviction. We should repro locally with high-concurrency harness.

samir: I'll open a follow-up ticket with repro steps and link to perf traces. Also want a small change: make batching hysteresis change gated by host_memory_pressure metric so we don't expand windows during memory pressure.

maria: Nice triage — actions agreed: rollback confirmed, warmpool bump in flight, alerts + perf probe added, follow-up ticket for kernel memory regression + batching gating.

kevin: :thumbsup: I'll keep an eye for any re-rollouts and coordinate a staged canary with memory profiling enabled.

sre-jen: Assigning postmortem ticket to @samir, priority P2. Please include timeline, metrics screenshots, and repro.

maria: Thanks folks. Closing thread for now — ping here if any regressions. :white_check_mark:
